fifth_flake.signature: expected true, actual false; got 192.0.2.1 first out of [192.0.2.1 2001:db8::1]
fifth_flake.mechanism: not a bound on one duration but a race between two timers: preferredFamilyGrace=50ms, the preferred family answers at grace/5=10ms, the fixture's fallbackDelay=2*grace=100ms, so the host must win a 90ms window
fifth_flake.candidate_fix: set fallbackDelay to time.Hour; the test's own comment already states that the grace release is the only mechanism under test
fifth_flake.candidate_validated: 300/300 at load 220-280, the same band the baseline failed in
fifth_flake.why_the_candidate_was_insufficient: with the fallback cadence already out of reach the fixed binary still failed 2/200 at load ~450, and the failure showed a SINGLE dialled candidate - so the grace timer itself (50ms) was beating the fixture's 10ms sleep; at that point the product is correct and the test was reporting a false failure. There were TWO competitors, not one.
final_fix: cadence moved out of reach: graceOrderOutOfReachCadence = 10 * graceOrderDeadline

the fixture publishes the non-preferred family then the preferred one back to back from one goroutine with no sleep, so 'the preferred family answered within the grace window' holds however slow the host is
fifth_flake.counter_proof: removing the grace hold from resolve.go turns both tests and both subtests red; a first injection (grace timer = 0) was DISCARDED as unusable because Go's select picks randomly between a ready timer and a ready channel, so it reddened only one test

items.title: Scope.Close completion boundary
confirmed_semantics: Close joins the cleanup drain and nothing else
it does not wait for a Start already running that has not reached Add()
a late Add runs the cleanup synchronously, after Close returned
a late cleanup's error is only logged and never folded into the already-returned closeErr, which is final
a Start on a closed Scope cannot report success

reentrancy.evidence: of 219 production scope.Add sites exactly 5 close any *Scope, all nested child scopes created by the component (supported parent->child direction); the 35 scope-closing call sites are all field-qualified

masque.witness_check: with the guard disabled the test fails with listen tcp 127.0.0.1:54649: bind: address already in use

tun.fix: non-blocking startupGate with sync.Once; a lock-across-activation design DEADLOCKED close (the -race run wedged to the 600s timeout) and was rejected

not_guaranteed: Box.Close() does not imply every in-flight Start has terminated
a late cleanup's failure is invisible to Close's caller
a Start that registers nothing is invisible to the Scope
Close is not reentrant on the same Scope
